premises: Single-phase fcc FeCoNiMnCu films are magnetically soft with coercivity ~10 Oe
RTA on FeCoNiMnCu yields single fcc phase and ~40× coercivity increase, but coercivity remains modest due to cubic symmetry
Adding 50 at.% Pt and RTA induces single L10 high-entropy intermetallic phase
L10 ordering with Pt provides low-symmetry structure and strong spin-orbit coupling, giving high magnetic anisotropy
Pt addition and RTA produce 3 orders of magnitude coercivity increase over the base alloy
